title: tenant-schedule-and-credential-providers-for-private-helm
author: Maya Chen
description: Context: Private deployments have diverse networking and secret storage topologies (node-local agents, projected KMS tokens, and external secret managers). We need a Helm-values-first approach to let operators select credential providers for init hooks and to schedule tenant init jobs with per-tenant rate, jitter and network-affinity profiles. This PR introduces a tenant-aware init scheduler and pluggable 'hook credential providers' for the Private Helm chart so operators can configure credential fetch semantics without patching templates. Motivation: reduce manual templating and ad-hoc post-install scripting during on-prem installs, and make upgrade/rollback safer by fencing init jobs on network prerequisites. What this PR does (summary): - Adds charts/private/values.schema.json additions describing new top-level keys: initScheduler, hookCredentialSources and networkPrereqs - Introduces templates: charts/private/templates/init-scheduler.yaml (CronJob-backed scheduler with per-tenant concurrency annotations), charts/private/templates/hook-credential-agent.yaml (sidecar/DaemonSet variant controlled by values), and charts/private/templates/_credential-helpers.tpl (sprig helpers and functions for provider selection) - Adds installer code: installer/hooks/credential_provider.go (small agent wrapper used for testing and local installers) - Adds e2e coverage: tests/e2e/private-init-network.test.ts and a fixture values file examples/values-private-credential-providers.yaml - Populates docs/values-hook-credential.md with recommended provider configurations (node-agent, projected-kms, external-vault) and migration instructions Migration path and operator notes: - New values are additive. Default behavior is unchanged: init jobs will continue to mount in-cluster secrets when hookCredentialSources is not set. - To opt into network-backed credentials, set hookCredentialSources.type to one of [node-agent, projected-kms, external-vault] and follow the docs for RBAC/volumeMount requirements. - For upgrades, a new values block initScheduler.fenceOnNetwork=true will gate init waves until a reachability probe succeeds (default off to avoid surprising long upgrades). Checklist: - [x] values.schema.json additions - [x] templates and helper functions - [x] minimal agent shim for installer tests - [x] unit tests for helper template functions - [x] e2e test covering network fence and credential retrieval - [x] docs and migration notes Commits: - chore(init-scheduler): scaffold tenant schedule template and CRD-like values - feat(credential-provider): add credential agent shim and helper template functions - test(e2e): add private init network e2e test and values fixture - docs: add values-hook-credential.md and migration guide - fix(helm): correct ownerReference handling and volume mount ordering Notes about implementation details: - The template helper _credential_provider takes the hookCredentialSources map and renders the appropriate volumes/volumeMounts for node-agent (hostPath + tolerations), projected-kms (projected service account token + projected config) and external-vault (CSI driver secret provider) - The init-scheduler is implemented as a namespaced CronJob that spawns tenant-specific Jobs with concurrencyPolicy set from values. We include annotations to allow Dedicated controllers to honor tenant throughput quotas. - The fence probe performs an HTTP/TCP check (configurable) against a values-defined endpoint and will pause rollout of subsequent tenant waves until check succeeds or timeout expires (values.initScheduler.fenceTimeout). CI: - unit (go/tests): pass - lint (helm/chart-lint): pass - e2e/private (k8s): initially flaky due to CI networking; second run passed. See ci/logs/1288883-e2e-run-2 for details Review summary and related Linear items: - Linked Linear: ENG-5219, ENG-6102 - Related support ticket SUP-8842 (customer requested node-attached hook secrets) Why this is different from previous hook work: previous PRs focused on sequencing and backoff semantics; this PR focuses on making credential sourcing pluggable and adding a network-aware fence for multi-tenant init waves. Backwards compatibility: no breaking changes by default; operators must opt into new providers.
release_notes:
- Added tenant-aware init scheduler with optional network fencing.
- Introduced hookCredentialSources to allow node-agent, projected-kms, or external-vault providers.
- New helper templates for credential wiring and migration guidance in docs/values-hook-credential.md.
